Questions about ScrollLok

Learn how ScrollLok can help parents create healthier boundaries around social media and app use.

?

What is ScrollLok?

ScrollLok is an Android parental control app designed to help parents manage social media and other distracting apps.

?

Can parents schedule app blocking?

Yes. Parents can choose which apps to manage and set schedules for times when those apps should be blocked.

?

Who is ScrollLok for?

ScrollLok is built for parents who want practical tools to reduce distracting social media use and encourage healthier digital routines.

?

Where can I get ScrollLok?

ScrollLok is being prepared for Android. You can join the launch waiting list or visit the Google Play page for the current testing availability.
